title: process_dio_bytes retains prior gateway_centric when DODAG Config option absent (behavior flip)
description: Old code unconditionally reset flag per-DIO (removed at dodag.c:459-481 during k35h fix); now written only when config!=NULL (:369-371) so stale gateway_centric=true survives indefinitely on same-DODAG DIos lacking the option. Reset when config==NULL or document Rust/Python-parity rationale for retain semantics.
